platform: Linux x64, isolated Chromium and actual VS Code preview webview
methodology: Geometry: same bundled fonts/dependencies; first compile in separate fresh WASM processes, then seven comment edits; 1200 px paint and five viewport repaints; excludes network, initialization and debounce. First-compile values are individual observations, not a universal latency guarantee. WASM memory is linear-memory capacity, not browser RSS.

geometry_round_join_union.strategy: Union overlapping round disks in balanced batches on the original shared integer grid before combining with the stroke; no flattening tolerance change. Dense join union activates above 16000 disk vertices.
geometry_round_join_union.holes_and_transformed_boundaries_regress: passed; bidirectional sampled boundary displacement below 0.0001 mm

stalled_cdn_font_initialization.definition: Real worker and SHA-256 verified packaged fonts; shim holds CDN fetch until AbortSignal fires; local network unchanged. New path gives CDN a 100 ms head start, races packaged copy, aborts losing requests.

viewport_backpressure.definition: 13 real zoom changes, DPR 2; worker paint replies held by harness. One in-flight request and one latest pending request, then release replies and confirm final Canvas dimensions.

changes: Consume decoded DynamicImage into RGBA instead of cloning existing RGBA pixels
Add consuming RgbaFrame.into_rgba() while retaining rgba getter
Canvas Uint8ClampedArray views share transferred Uint8Array buffers instead of copying
pixel_ownership.benchmark: 1200 px shadow/glow, same RGBA hash; readback median remained 1.3 ms, so no measurable readback speedup is claimed. Rendering effects remain the dominant work.

actual_vscode_content_edits.definition: native request enqueue to resources loaded and WASM Canvas drawn in VS Code; excludes edit debounce

scientific_fixture.interpretation: The optimized scientific fixture remains near its earlier performance: paired native medians 104 and 105 ms; actual content-edit request-to-visible median 411 ms. This change primarily improves dense cold geometry and browser initialization/viewport scheduling, rather than all edits.

remaining_costs: Dense round joins still take around 2 seconds on a first WASM compile
1200 px alpha effects still require around 70 ms per actual WASM paint; repaint coalescing avoids obsolete work but does not remove effect computation
